title: diorama skin
description: skins/<id>.json: how one app's interface is made see-through. See docs/skins.md.

extends.description: Another skin's id. Its slots come first; vars merge by name.

urls.description: Page URLs this skin applies to. * matches anything.

exclude.description: URLs to skip even if they match, such as transparent overlay windows.

scheme.description: How to tell the app's light and dark modes apart. Without a match, the app's text colour decides.

probe.description: Element whose text colour is read. Default: body.

scope.description: Elements that define the app's variables. :root means <html>.

values.description: CSS custom properties to override. Values can use var(--diorama-glass) and the other palette variables.

role.description: clear: transparent. glass: frosted panel. strong: more opaque glass for menus and inputs. blur: backdrop blur only.

required.description: Report the skin as broken when nothing matches.

stylesheet.description: Extra CSS file next to this one. Prefix every rule with html.diorama-on.
